case.summary: Customer C08106 disputed a $128.33 online charge on 2016-12-29, stating they did not make the purchase. The bank's fraud model assigned a calibrated score of 0.01 (low risk), flagging only a new device and a mismatch in M4 signals. When presented with merchant, date, and device details, the cardholder recognized the charge as a household member's purchase on their account and withdrew the dispute. Per Policy R3, the case closes as CLOSE_NO_FRAUD with no further action.
